purpose: Small prospective check of the negative mechanism screen; not promotion to the large pilot
enrollment: All fixed new problems; keep early completion and ineligibility; no replacement
selection: Choose and durably record each action before generating any continuation outcome for that problem
shared_checkpoint: Common online initial prefix across policies; charge it once to collection and once to each hypothetical episode
continuation_seeds: Same prespecified seed per problem across policies; no equivalence or common-random-number variance claim
sharing: Identical selected actions may reuse one generated continuation per problem; record the coupling and charge full hypothetical deployment cost per policy
analysis: Equal problem weights; family-stratified paired descriptive intervals; no efficacy or equivalence claim from n=24
scale_gate: No automatic expansion regardless of favorable result; review independent precision and costs first
